headline: A bot task state is a small polymorphic record embedded in the approach controller at task+3F8h, with a seven-slot interface: +0h dtor, +4h enter, +8h exit, +Ch tick(float dt), +10h/+14h/+18h unread predicates, and a moveto/follow-only +1Ch set_desired_speed. 00411E70 pushes {name, state} pairs into a plain vector at approach+FCh and the names are never looked up: every transition compares state pointers through the setter 009A56C0, which calls the outgoing state's +8h and the incoming state's +4h. The per-tick entry into a task is vtable slot +64h from 009998A0, not the +54h of docs/BOT_TASKS.md; +54h is called only on bot->+58h[0] at 0099AE28 and 0099AEAE. The depth-charge rule 009A5870 runs before the state's own tick and drives moveto/follow -> prepare -> attackrun/aim/turnto/goaway/leave -> done. Ordnance release is one shared request 007BBBA0(unit) that raises a flag on the device at unit+DECh; the depth charge drops from the aim tick 009A4010 and both classes also drop on leaving the done/prepare state (009A48D0, 009D2570). unit+9D8h is the unit's follow target: 007B8AD0 returns +9D8h == 0 and selects moveto over follow, in the constructor and again on every tick.

negative_results.claim: The state registry is not a name lookup
negative_results.evidence: ghidra xrefs 00d1f5c4 (DepthCharge/attackrun) returns exactly one reference, the registration at 009a30da; every transition in 009a5870 and 009a57d0 compares state pointers

negative_results.claim: Slot +54h is not the per-tick entry
negative_results.evidence: 009998a0 calls only MOV EAX,[EDX+0x64]; CALL EAX, at 009998fb and 0099995a; a scan of the whole .text for CALL dword ptr [reg+54h] finds one occurrence, 00c03b1b in the CRT; the two MOV EAX,[EDX+0x54] sites 0099ae28 and 0099aeae take ECX from bot->+58h[0], not from a task loop

009a3770 and 009d07b0 contain no call to 007bbba0; the scan of every E8 targeting 007bbba0 places the depth-charge sites at 009a4620 (aim), 009a48ea/009a4909 (done/prepare exit), 009a4a89, 009a5746 and 009a67ab
its body only raises dev->+61h, +68h, +11h on unit->+DECh and increments unit->+C20h; it has no callees

corrections.was: docs/BOT_TASKS.md: the scheduler's per-tick slot is +54h, with the loop over bot+58h not located
corrections.is: the per-tick slot is +64h, called from 009998a0 at 009998fb and 0099995a; +54h is called on bot->+58h[0] from 0099ae28 and 0099aeae
corrections.evidence: MOV EAX,[EDX+0x64] at 009998e8 and 00999947 with ECX = ESI = task; the depth-charge +64h body 009a66c0 calls the approach update, the transition rule and the state tick

corrections.is: the body returns unit->+9D8h == 0, i.e. has NO follow target
corrections.evidence: three instructions; 009a52ae-009a52bc selects moveto when the result is non-zero, and 009a5870 steps 4 and 5 make the same choice

corrections.was: docs/BOT_TASKS.md: what the tasks write is the pilot control block at unit+9D4h
corrections.is: unit+9D4h carries the altitude limits; the per-tick heading, speed and weapon requests go to the command block at task+4h, reached as approach->+18h
corrections.evidence: 009f9980 sets approach+18h = task+4; 009c18c0, 009c1850, 009a3770, 009a4010 and 009d07b0 all write through approach->+18h; 0099d300 is called on task+4h at 00999907
